notes.title: Try Dying is releasing today!
notes.content:
Few hours till release!

If you played Demo, that's what you need to expect in full game:

 94 levels compared to 40 levels in Demo. Including a few new features like electric eel and really mad levels for those who want something really special!
 New backgrounds for all levels.
 Achievements!
 Lots of fixes, balancing, and QoL improvements. Thanks for your feedback on this!


If you need a party to play with, join our discord channel!

notes.title: Demo 0.4.7 patchnote
notes.content:
- Added new level backgrounds.
- Fixed a few crashes caused by unusual placement of portals and platforms in the level editor.
- The Steam page opened by the "Wishlist" button now appears in the Steam overlay instead of the browser.
- GUI fixes for non-English localizations.

notes.title: Demo 0.4.3 patchnote
notes.content:
- Increased spawn rate of interactive objects, especially for two-player mode
- Fixed several issues with text display in non-English locales
- Made improvements to the Elevator to Heaven level
- Fixed a crash that occurred when moving outside the level, possibly caused by creating a specific level in the level editor, though the exact reason is unclear :)
